Store writes (src/utils/directoryStore.ts, #254 onward). update(fn): take the store lock, bump the epoch odd, rescan, re-read sidecars, let fn decide from the store AS IT STANDS UNDER THE LOCK, then write. save(data) = update(() => data); helpers updateEntries/updateAliasMap/updateConfirmMap/updateAll. The lock is O_EXCL and NOT re-entrant.
ORDER: a confirm list that gains flags is written first; then entry writes; then the alias map; then deletes; a list that loses flags last. Writes before deletes, so a failed write never loses the source.
ROLLBACK on a failed write: put back each written file, LAST WRITE FIRST, by the file the path opened (lstat dev:ino), not by key — a fold twin is restored, not deleted; if an undo fails, keep the gained flags. Every exit writes the even epoch (#262); errors are StoreWriteError (one line, real file, errno kept, code IO).
TWO STORES: updateUnderBothLocks takes project then global. inspect() reads a store unlocked when its lock dir isn't writable (#269).
LOCK WAITS: store writes wait STORE_LOCK_WAIT_MS 1000; everything else (session locks, migration) the 31ms default. LockTimeoutError is code IO, one line (#266).
HIDDEN KEYS (#267): an entry and a namespace under one key — the view shows the entry, the keys under it are UnifiedData.hidden; a hidden file is deleted only when the write removes the entry above it or lists it in UnifiedData.removed.
TEST GUARD (#274): under RVR_TEST=1 every write path refuses RVR_TEST_CHECKOUT.
